services_shape: set lessons with a chosen trainer, and group classes booked by the spot; the dog is booked under its owner
questions_before_times: the dog's name and age, and one dog or two
does the dog bark or lunge at other dogs? (then the reactive dog lesson, or a private lesson before any class)
a puppy under 6 months? (the puppy class or the puppy start-up visit)
who will handle the dog (a junior handler lesson needs a parent there)
safety_stop: a bite or a dog fight happening now; someone badly hurt by a dog
a dog that is very sick or hurt now (like after eating something)
first_steps: A private lesson before a group class
license: if: training a dog needs no state license of its own; a place where dogs are kept, boarded or trained for pay may need a kennel or facility license where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state form)
staff_skills: private lessons, reactive dogs, puppies, classes; behavior evaluations only by Lauren at the center, and by Marcus or Sam at home; home lessons only by trainers cleared for them
messages_never: bite history, health notes and incident notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the dog's record
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
